Manuel Azaña Díaz ( Spanish pronunciation: [maˈnwel aˈθaɲa] ; 10 January 1880 – 3 November 1940) was a Spanish politician who served as Prime Minister of the Second Spanish Republic (1931–1933 and 1936), organizer of the Popular Front in 1935 and the last President of the Republic (1936–1939). He has been called the father of the Republic [ 1 ] and was the most prominent leader of the Republican cause during the Spanish Civil War of 1936–1939.
